gamefaqs.section: GameBoy Advance GameShark SP Save File (North America)

format: a Game Boy Pokemon Red/Blue save, not a GBA one: 32768 bytes of MBC3 cartridge RAM (player RED at 0x2598) followed by a 44-byte VBA/BGB-style clock footer (5 + 5 u32 LE clock registers, u32 LE Unix time 1730920272 = 2024-11-06 19:11:12 UTC). No GameShark SP header; the 32-bit-time footer is the older one, not what mGBA, VBA-M or BGB write now (48 bytes), so the emulator that wrote it is not identified

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/gb-footer.py IN OUT.srm: keeps the 32768 bytes of cartridge RAM and drops the clock footer (Pokemon Red has no clock; the libretro cores read the RAM alone)

note: Posted on the GBA FireRed/LeafGreen page in the GameShark SP section; it is a Game Boy save. Red and Blue keep the same save layout and nothing in the file says which cartridge wrote it, so it is filed and verified as Red. The libretro runs went through tools/make-save.py --dry --srm, with scripts/gb/skyemu.options for SkyEmu as in the gb entries.
